name: PixelPunch Studios
description: Level up your game with PixelPunch Studios.
story: PixelPunch Studios is a burgeoning game development company based in Lisbon, focused on creating innovative and engaging mobile gaming experiences. They see motorsport sponsorship as a way to reach a broader audience of tech-savvy individuals and showcase their commitment to high performance and cutting-edge technology. They are particularly interested in partnering with teams that demonstrate a drive to succeed and resonate with a younger demographic.
